summary: This class discusses the custom of visiting the cemetery during the High Holiday season, covering the reasons for the practice and when it is performed. It examines the timing of the visits relative to Rosh Hashanah, Aseret Yeme Teshubah, and Yom Kippur, along with various sources and explanations.
questions: When is the best time during the High Holiday season to visit the cemetery?
What are the reasons for visiting the cemetery before the holidays?
How do the souls of the departed relate to prayers at gravesides?
What does the book Bet El say about visiting the cemetery?
